revit_create_view_template_from_view: Create a new view template from an existing view.
revit_apply_view_template: Apply or assign a view template to one or more views.
revit_delete_view_template: Delete a view template. maxUsedByViews caps dependent-view/deleted-id response previews.
revit_save_selection: Save a named selection. IDs are omitted from the response by default; opt in with includeElementIds and maxElementIdResults.
revit_load_selection: Load a bounded page from a saved selection filter. Use startIndex + maxResults (hard max 1000).
revit_list_saved_selections: List all saved selection filters in the document.
revit_delete_saved_selection: Delete a saved selection filter by name or ID.
revit_select_elements: Update active selection in the Revit UI. Runs pure UI selection mutation (must NOT run in transaction).
revit_workflow_clash_review: Run clash detection, optionally create a review view, color clash hits, and add review markers with an auditable workflow report.
revit_workflow_model_audit: Run a read-only composite model audit covering warnings, families, views, schedules, and MEP connectivity signals.
revit_workflow_room_documentation: Generate room documentation records, optional callouts, room tags, finish schedule, and sheet placement.
revit_workflow_sheet_set: Create a coordinated sheet set, place views and schedules, and set sheet parameters with dry-run and rollback reporting.

revit_workflow_naming_normalization: Analyze and optionally rename views, sheets, levels, and grids using deterministic normalization or a token pattern.
